mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Boiled, (water, milk or Ghee.)
E.
श्रा to boil, aff. क्त, form. irr.; as applied to any other substances, the form is श्राण or श्रपित.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Gone.
E.
सृ to go, aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
1 A road, a path, a way.
2 Going, proceeding.
3 Hurting, injuring.
E.
सृ to go, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Going, moving.
E.
सृ to go, क्वरप् aff., तुक् augment.
